gen_sql.src:
SELECT
    status_cd AS STATUS_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS CNT,
    SUM(order_amt) AS ORDER_AMT,
    SUM(qty) AS QTY
FROM mv_bt.orders_a
GROUP BY
    status_cd
gen_sql.tgt:
SELECT
    STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD,
    COUNT(*) AS CNT,
    SUM(ORDER_AMT) AS ORDER_AMT,
    SUM(QTY) AS QTY
FROM mv_bt.tgt_orders
GROUP BY
    STATUS_CD
